create_TimeManager: create a TimeManager instance to track simulated time with pause and resume support
get_current_time: get the current simulated time by calling the time method on a TimeManager instance
pause_resume_time: pause the simulation clock with pause and resume it later with resume on TimeManager
reset_time: reset the TimeManager to a new start time or current time using the reset method
add_time_offset: add an offset to the simulated time using add_offset on a TimeManager instance
